_about: Semi-finals, third-place games and finals of major team competitions, and the deciding games of best-of series (NBA, MLB, NHL) and the Super Bowl. Harvested from Wikipedia's match templates (each record cites its page). time: local kick-off/start in the zone tz_east the page states, or the venue's historical zone from the tz database; a record without a time is cast at local noon. stage: final, semi-final, third-place, qualifier/eliminator (IPL), 'final (deciding game)' for series. decided_by: regular, extra time, penalties, overtime, super over, DLS, tie, no result, walkover. Two-legged semi-final legs are not included.
